# Front differential locking and drop bushings

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> **Some safety-critical values on this page are not confirmed** (marked [Unverified] or [Partial]): they come from one source or are only partly supported. Verify against the factory service manual before use; later runs re-check them against new sources.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Rotate the front locker, seat the ring gear, and install drop bushings with metric bolts. [t2125]

[Partial] Drop the front cross member to lower the diff carrier for easier installation. [t2125]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Drop the front cross member to lower the diff carrier.
2. [Partial] Remove the ring gear bolts and use a pry bar or rubber mallet to seat it back onto the carrier if needed.

_Procedure reported by [t2125]._

## Specifications

- **All Bushings**: 50-64 foot pounds [t2125] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Bearing Caps**: 65-72 foot pounds [t2125] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Bracket to Frame**: 50-64 foot pounds [t2125] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Cross Member to Differential**: 50-64 foot pounds [t2125] ([Unverified] single report)
- **CV Axles**: 33 foot pounds with thread lock [t2125] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Differential Cover Bolts**: 29-36 foot pounds [t2125] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Drive Shaft**: 64 foot pounds [t2125] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Long Axle Flange**: 23-31 foot pounds [t2125] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Short Axle Bolt**: 25-33 foot pounds [t2125] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- [Partial] Use a modified scissor jack turned into a steel platform to support the differential for easier lifting. [t2125]
- [Partial] If removing the entire front cross member, attach it to the diff before installation to lift straight up instead of at an angle. [t2125]
- [Partial] Use a motorcycle jack to lift the diff in place; it takes about 30 seconds and stabilizes the carrier. [t2125]
- If using standard jack stands, you may need two people or a transmission jack because pushing the heavy diff into place is awkward alone. [t2125]
- The pin that must be punched out only goes one way due to a tapered hole. [t2125]
- [Partial] Dropping the front cross member makes installation significantly easier than dropping just the bushings. [t2125]

## Common mistakes

- Mixing up left and right thrust washers during disassembly. [t2125]
- Failing to machine down a pressed flange lock nut on the driver's side axle gear, preventing cam gears from sliding in through the carrier window. [t2125]
- Forgetting to disconnect the breather hose before lifting, causing it to hang up on something. [t2125]
- Trying to push the diff into place without adequate support or leverage. [t2125]
- Struggling with the ring gear seating; use two bolts threaded opposite each other and ratchet incrementally to seat it fully. [t2125]
